comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
It's worth mentioning that there are at least five items which can be found in this city through Special Search -- meaning that if you use the Search skill (apparently it's best to do so by the altar before the pyramid, but I'm told the light likes to move around, so check elsewhere in town if you don't see it there), regardless of your skill rank, an Observe-styled column of light may appear close by; if it does, use Search again in the center of that light, and you'll get a random item from this list:

Golden Clothes Trunk
Golden Bookends
Jaguar Warrior's Sword
Eagle Warrior's Spear
Gold Falda

If there are any other items besides those, I'm yet to get them. It also looks like once an item is found, there's a few hours in-between before the column of light reappears. Good luck, fellow treasure-hunters.
